rationale: Identity: the held original (66 FR 66267, Dec. 18, 2001) is Executive Order 13244, Providing an Order of Succession Within the Department of the Interior. Section 4 of the held EO 13915 text (85 FR 21733-21734, Apr. 14, 2020) reads 'Executive Order 13244 of December 18, 2001 (Providing an Order of Succession Within the Department of the Interior), is hereby revoked.' EO 13261 (2002) only amended it. No held later instrument revives it. Provisional no is supported.
